# 3 bed end of terrace house for sale

> Gallagher Quigley are delighted to present this exceptional three-bedroom end-of-terrace family home to the market. Expertly redesigned and extended by its current owners, this stunning property has been transformed into a bright, spacious, and contemporary home, offering superb open-plan living throughout.
